 Home News Club statement manolo marquez Club Statement: Manolo Marquez
 06 November 2026 Mumbai City FC confirms that the club and Manolo Márquez have agreed to part ways for the remainder of the MG ISL 2026/27 season. 
 With this development, the club’s immediate focus remains on the ongoing season. The club will continue to compete with the current squad while looking to strengthen the team in the coming days. The ownership remains confident in the squad and its ability to deliver. 
 Sujay Sharma, Director of Football, Mumbai City FC, said: 
 “As with every ISL club this season, we are navigating a new era for Indian football. In many ways, this marks a fresh start for the top tier of the Indian game. We brought Manolo to the club for his experience and track record in Indian football. Our focus now remains on supporting the first team and achieving our objectives for the ongoing season. Further updates on the squad and coaching setup will be communicated through the club’s official channels in due course.” 
 Neither party will be making any further comments on this matter.
